stile: digital oil painting, fantasy storybook illustration, rich warm colors, soft cinematic lighting, painterly brush strokes, no text, no letters, no watermark

vlad.descrizione: Vlad, a 13-year-old boy with short messy dark brown hair, brown eyes, light freckles, slim build, friendly curious face; he wears a small dark metal feather-shaped pendant on a thin chain around his neck; in winter scenes he wears a thick red-and-grey winter jacket, wool hat and scarf

vlad_armatura.descrizione: Vlad in his magical golden armor: polished golden plates with glowing golden runes, a glowing firebird feather emblem on the chest, golden helmet with a crest of orange fire feathers, warm orange glow between the plates; armor design may change with the situation but always golden with the firebird feather emblem

ludovica.descrizione: Ludovica, a 13-year-old girl with long wavy light brown hair, big expressive eyes, brave and quick; in winter scenes she wears a thick teal winter coat, a white wool hat and mittens

prof_siligato.descrizione: Professor Marcella Siligato, a friendly woman aged about 57 with short curly white hair (a pencil tucked into it), round glasses, kind lined face, warm smile, light shirt and long blue skirt; in winter a warm long coat

nonna_tanya.descrizione: Nonna Tatiana (Tanya), Vlad's grandmother, around 70, kind and mysterious, grey hair in a bun under a colorful Russian headscarf, warm amber eyes, embroidered dark cardigan, orange skirt, gentle smile; in winter scenes a long fur-collared coat

arione.descrizione: Arione, an ancient Greek bard and ghost, about 30 years old in appearance, tall and lean with long wavy dark hair and a short salt-crusted beard threaded with tiny seaweed, sea-green eyes, a ragged white linen tunic and a deep midnight-blue cloak that shimmers like the night sea, holding a silver-blue ancient lyre with nine strings, a faint moonlit glow around him, gentle and kind

ded_moroz.descrizione: Ded Moroz (Grandfather Frost), a very tall old man with a long white beard down to his belt, bushy white eyebrows, kind icy-blue eyes, a long blue-and-silver embroidered coat trimmed with white fur, a tall rounded fur hat, felt boots, grumpy and gentle; he carries a crystal staff (sometimes missing)

snegurochka.descrizione: Snegurochka (the Snow Maiden), a 13-year-old girl with a very long pale blonde braid, pale skin, bright ice-blue eyes, a light blue coat embroidered with silver snowflakes and a white fur hat, a faint frosty shimmer around her, friendly and shy

marena.descrizione: Marena, the Lady of Winter, a tall beautiful and sad woman with pale skin, extremely long jet-black hair, a crown of sharp ice crystals, a long white-and-pale-blue gown that leaves a trail of frost, dark eyes shining like frozen lakes, proud and lonely
